thread:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout (job 1987654322) to us-west-2 started 20% -> alerts: p95 latency +38%, error rate 3.2% (>2.0%). Auto-rollback scheduled in 5m unless manual override.

maria: I see the alert. Which endpoints are spiking? any dedicated-customer hits?

jon: /v1/generate (model: rwd-llama-v2-13b) is the main culprit. Errors are 5xx from runtime when sequence length > 1k. Dedicated pools show a small fraction of traffic but one large customer hits long-context paths. Logs show KV cache misses after the kernel selector change.

ashley: I'm oncall. Proposal: pause the auto-rollback, pin dedicated pool to runtime v2.4.1, push a targeted hotfix 2.4.2 that reverts the kernel selector change for long sequences in hosted. Then resume canary. Less customer impact than full revert. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

prashant: +1 for conditional approach. Auto-rollback is noisy for mixed workloads. We should also enable a strict fallback policy for the dedicated pool while we test hotfix.

maria: agree. I'll draft the release-note snippet and comms to support. Ashley, can you run the pause + pin commands?

ashley: doing it now.

```
# pause canary
deployctl rollout pause --job 1987654322
# apply pin for dedicated pool
deployctl pool pin --name dedicated --version "runtime:2.4.1"
# set fallback policy
deployctl policy set --pool dedicated --fallback runtime:2.4.1
```

ashley: pause + pin applied. deploy-bot shows: "canary paused by ashley (manual override)". Auto-rollback cancelled.

deploy-bot: Canary paused by ashley at 1987654360. Pin applied to pool dedicated -> runtime:2.4.1. Auto-rollback cancelled per manual override.

jon: I'll prepare a narrow hotfix branch that disables the kernel selector for sequences > 1024 and run unit + long-seq integration tests. Expect build + small e2e in ~30m.

maria: support_lead, can you prepare a short customer note for the dedicated customer: explain we applied a safety pin and are rolling a hotfix; give ETA ~1h. Keep messaging internal-first (CS + AE) until we confirm fix.

support_lead: on it. Draft will go to #support tomorrow, sharing now in PMs to AEs for the affected account.

prashant: after hotfix build, let's do a 5% canary to hosted-only routes (not dedicated) for 10m, watch p95, error rate, and kvcache hit ratio. If green, expand and then lift the dedicated pin.

ashley: deployment commands for hotfix (ready when jon pushes):

```
deployctl deploy --service runtime --image runtime:2.4.2-hotfix --job 1987654345
# targeted canary to hosted routes only
deployctl rollout start --job 1987654345 --region usw2 --percent 5 --exclude-pool dedicated
```

jon: hotfix built and pushed: runtime:2.4.2-hotfix. Triggering the hosted-only canary now.

deploy-bot: Rollout 1987654345 -> 5% hosted-only canary started. Monitoring hooks attached: p95, 5xx-rate, kvcache-hit.

maria: I'm publishing internal release-note blurb: "Applied safety pin to dedicated pool to mitigate long-sequence failures; deploying hotfix to hosted canary. Will notify customers after verification." Will add to release channel once green.

support_lead: CS notified internal AEs; drafting customer email template now.

ashley: after 12m monitoring: p95 returned to baseline, 5xx dropped to <0.5%, kvcache-hit increased to expected. Can we widen to 25% hosted?

prashant: Widen to 25% hosted. Keep dedicated pinned until we get a few hours of stability and run regression tests on a copy of the large-customer workload.

jon: widening now. Also kicking off a replay of the long-seq test against a staging dedicated replica (sanitized) to validate.

deploy-bot: Rollout 1987654345 -> widened to 25% hosted at 1987654380. Metrics ok so far.

maria: Next steps checklist: 1) monitor 2h, 2) run long-seq replay against dedicated replica, 3) if green, unpin dedicated and resume normal rollout, 4) publish release notes and customer message. I'll own comms.

ashley: noted. I'll update runbook with the manual override steps and add the exact deployctl commands we used.

prashant: once we unpin, plan a gradual 10->50->100% expansion with the same metric gates. Also add a regression eval set to Redwood Optimize to detect similar regressions earlier.

maria: thanks everyone. Closing thread when we unpin. If anything regresses, re-open and we'll roll back. :white_check_mark:
